title: MCGifs
description: Render any GIF on your overlays.
body:
Minecraft mod that renders animated GIFs directly in the overlay. Includes an in-game screen to download GIFs by pasting a URL, with no external tools required, and displays/updates them in real time on the UI (you don't even need to save the world when exiting Minecraft). Keep in mind that the GIF renders above almost any other overlay


- Press G to open the download screen
- Paste a URL and download
- That's it, if your URL is correct, the GIF should download and render almost instantly

### **Usages**
- Drag GIFs in your screen
- Right Click to hide/show, remove or rename the GIF
- Resize by holding a corner and dragging

### Saves
The GIFs and the .json save file are located in the _MCGifs_ folder inside the .minecraft directory

## Warning
Normally, copying a GIF link from a web page does not give a direct downloadable file. The link usually points to a web page that returns HTML or redirects, not the actual GIF file, so if your GIF is not downloading, that's the reason. To fix it:
- Open the GIF on the page (Google Images, Tenor, Giphy, etc).
- Right-click the GIF.
- Click “Open image in new tab”.
- Copy the new tab URL.
- If it contains "media/images/etc" in the URL, it’s the real link.

**A FEW GIFs may render/play way faster than the one you saw in Internet, I don't know fully why, but it's probably because of how it was uploaded to the internet (it's not a bug)**
